statement:
The recorded value is unsafe and incorrect for this case: adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid risks a violent exothermic reaction, whereas the correct safety rule is to add acid to water.
The recorded step for PR-6 stated "the water is added to the acid," which is unsafe — adding water to concentrated sulfuric acid can cause violent boiling and splattering. Following the standard lab safety rule ("always add acid to water"), I ran the step as **acid into water**. The dilution step has been committed successfully.
